original: I see a cave! Let's take a break\nand rest in there!
Yamato, I know you're in a hurry,\nbut you'll get a cold if we don't\nwait out the snowstorm.
I'll go look for Takeru! You\nshould wait here and rest.
I'm all right, I'm wearing fur!\nI'm going, so just wait here,\nokay?
Takeru! I can't just sit here!
In the end, I couldn't find\nTakeru...\nAh! Yamato!
It's so cold...His body's almost\nfrozen. If I don't do something,\nhe's gonna freeze to death.
Looks like I'll have to use my\nfur. Nobody's looking, anyway...
And so, Gabumon took off his fur\nand put it on Yamato, who was in\npain.
Were you keeping me warm all this\ntime?
So you caught my cold instead? I'm\nsorry. But I feel a lot better.
So what do we do now?
Isn't it obvious? We need to find\neveryone else!
They were probably blown away to\ndifferent islands, so calm down.
Takeru's waiting for me to find\nhim!
We can't find them! But I bet\nthey're all doing just fine. Even\nTakeru!
Taichi! You've been staring off\ninto space. Why can't you bother\nhelping me look for everyone?
More importantly, Yamato, aren't\nyou worried about where this\nisland's going?
Devimon said we might be headed to\nthe land on the other side of the\nocean...
If we go there, maybe we'll find a\nway to find everyone!
You don't understand how I feel,\nwhen Takeru's not here!
This isn't the time to be\nfighting!
Takeru can't do anything on his\nown!
That was close! Are you okay,\nYamato?
A black gear! He's being\nmanipulated by Devimon!
Taichi, look! That broken wall has\nblack gears in it!
Those black gears are separating\nYamato and Takeru!\nFox Fire!
You're right! We're going back to\nInfinity Mountain!
Maybe Takeru will be there too...
